summary: In their Berlin shared apartment, Lukas boasts about his robot vacuum. It steals a sock and a slipper, turning him into the cleaner's servant. When he chooses a broom instead, the robot carries that away too.
cliffhanger: Tomorrow Lukas promises a foolproof breakfast machine; Marta doubts that anything he calls automatic can end well.
visual_hook: A robot vacuum is running away with Marta's bright yellow sock while Lukas proudly holds its remote.
comedy_setup: An overconfident flatmate claims his robot does all the housework.
comedy_payoff: He must chase the robot, and even his supposedly manual broom rides away on it.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Warum fährt dein Staubsauger mit meiner Socke spazieren?
scenes.fa: چرا جاروبرقی‌ات جوراب مرا به گردش برده؟
scenes.scene: In the colorful Berlin shared living room, Marta points in disbelief at a teal robot vacuum dragging a yellow sock; Lukas proudly holds its remote. Wide low angle with sock clearly visible.
scenes.motion: The vacuum darts across frame dragging the sock; Marta recoils with wide eyes while Lukas proudly raises the remote.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Er hilft beim Aufräumen. Ganz automatisch!
scenes.fa: او در مرتب‌کردن خانه کمک می‌کند. کاملاً خودکار!
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Lukas boasting beside the sofa; Marta looks skeptical, sock-dragging robot visible behind him.
scenes.motion: Lukas confidently presses his palm to his chest and raises a finger; the robot circles behind him; Marta folds her arms.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Dann ist meine zweite Socke wohl auch im Urlaub.
scenes.fa: پس جوراب دومم هم حتماً به تعطیلات رفته است.
scenes.scene: Marta points to her empty shoe and one bare foot, her other sock also missing, while looking dryly at Lukas; the robot rolls behind with a single yellow sock.
scenes.motion: Marta slowly raises one eyebrow and holds out the empty shoe; Lukas glances down and loses his confident smile.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Warte, ich drücke einfach auf diesen Knopf.
scenes.fa: صبر کن، فقط این دکمه را فشار می‌دهم.
scenes.scene: Lukas holds a small plain black remote with a single blank round button, Marta beside him watching his thumb; robot in background.
scenes.motion: Lukas theatrically presses the remote button; the robot makes a sharp turn toward his feet; Marta flinches.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Warum fährt er jetzt direkt auf dich zu?
scenes.fa: چرا حالا مستقیم به طرف تو می‌آید؟
scenes.scene: Low wide shot from behind the teal vacuum heading toward Lukas and Marta beside the couch; both faces remain clearly visible.
scenes.motion: The robot rolls toward Lukas; Marta points quickly at it; Lukas freezes then tries to look dignified.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Vielleicht erkennt er mich als seinen Chef.
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Lukas standing proudly, hand on hip, robot approaching his slipper; Marta stares at his foot.
scenes.motion: Lukas straightens and gives a pompous little salute to the robot while Marta leans sideways to inspect his feet.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Nein. Du stehst auf seinem Ladekabel.
scenes.scene: Marta bends slightly and points to the vacuum docking-station charging cable under Lukas's slipper; teal robot beside the sock.
scenes.motion: Marta taps Lukas's sleeve then points downward; Lukas looks down, lifts his foot, and makes a sheepish face.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Oh. Dann gehe ich besser zur Seite.
scenes.fa: اوه. پس بهتر است کنار بروم.
scenes.scene: Full-body shot of Lukas taking an exaggerated sideways step, accidentally leaving one white slipper directly in front of the robot; Marta reaches toward him.
scenes.motion: Lukas takes a huge awkward sideways step; one slipper slips off his foot and the robot nudges it forward; Marta reacts instantly.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Zu spät! Er hat schon deinen Hausschuh.
scenes.scene: Low medium-wide shot showing robot pushing Lukas's white slipper with the yellow sock attached; both roommates behind it.
scenes.motion: Marta reaches after the slipper but misses; the robot scoots around her hand; Lukas hops on one foot in surprise.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Gib den zurück! Ich brauche zwei!
scenes.fa: آن را پس بده! من دو تا لازم دارم!
scenes.scene: Lukas and Marta in a wide living-room shot; Lukas hopping comically behind the little vacuum as it pushes his slipper.
scenes.motion: Lukas hops twice after the robot with arms out for balance; Marta steps aside and points out its path with an amused grin.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Jetzt jagst du den Staubsauger. Sehr automatisch.
scenes.fa: حالا تو دنبال جاروبرقی می‌دوی. عجب کار خودکاری!
scenes.scene: Marta leans against the sofa with a deadpan smile; Lukas circles past behind her following his slipper on the robot.
scenes.motion: Marta dryly raises one eyebrow and gestures toward the chase; Lukas passes behind her, reaching unsuccessfully for the slipper.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Morgen kaufe ich einen ganz normalen Besen.
scenes.fa: فردا یک جاروی کاملاً معمولی می‌خرم.
scenes.scene: Lukas has recovered his slipper and sock and holds a simple broom vertically with its bristles resting on the stopped robot; Marta notices the setup.
scenes.motion: Lukas puts on the recovered slipper, triumphantly grips the broom handle, and turns away as the robot starts rolling beneath the bristles.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Gut. Aber dein Besen fährt gerade auch weg.
scenes.fa: خوب است. ولی جارویت هم دارد فرار می‌کند.
scenes.scene: Wide final gag: the robot slowly carries the broom sideways by its bristles while Lukas is left holding empty air; Marta points and laughs.
scenes.motion: The robot carries the broom out of Lukas's loose grip; his triumphant face collapses into disbelief; Marta laughs and points after the runaway broom.
